closing.summary: Big strengths are carb quality, vitamin B12, and fermented-food angle adds extra value, but the biggest weaknesses are low magnesium, low vitamin A, and low protein amount. It's good for practical meals, hormone health, and low-calorie volume because it's easy to build meals around, the fat section has enough useful fats for a support role, and it helps fill out a meal without many calories.
